metadata.name: US-100 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
metadata.description: Ultrasonic distance sensor with detection range of 2cm to 450cm, supports Trigger/Echo and UART modes
metadata.author: Moritz Kanemeier

connectionGuide.purpose: Power input for the sensor. Accepts 2.4V to 5V, typically connected to 3.3V or 5V from Pico.
warnings: Current consumption is approximately 2mA idle, 15mA during measurement
troubleshooting: If sensor doesn't respond: check power connection
If readings are erratic: ensure stable power supply

trig.name: TRIG/TX
trig.description: Trigger input (Echo mode) or UART TX (Serial mode)

connectionGuide.purpose: In Trigger/Echo mode: send a 10µs HIGH pulse to trigger measurement. In UART mode: serial transmit pin.
warnings: In Echo mode: requires 10µs pulse to trigger
In UART mode: connect to Pico RX pin, set jumper on back of sensor
troubleshooting: Echo mode: ensure trigger pulse is at least 10µs
UART mode: check jumper is set and baud rate is 9600

echo.name: ECHO/RX
echo.description: Echo output (Echo mode) or UART RX (Serial mode)

connectionGuide.purpose: In Trigger/Echo mode: outputs pulse width proportional to distance. In UART mode: serial receive pin.
warnings: Echo pulse can be up to 25ms for maximum range
Echo output is 5V when powered at 5V - may need voltage divider for 3.3V Pico GPIO
troubleshooting: If no echo: check trigger pulse timing
If echo always HIGH: object may be too close (<2cm)
For 3.3V GPIO: use voltage divider (2.2kΩ + 3.3kΩ) if powered at 5V

connectionGuide.purpose: Ground reference, connect to Pico GND.
warnings: Must share common ground with Pico
troubleshooting: If no response: verify ground connection

gnd2.name: GND-2
gnd2.description: Second ground connection (internally connected to GND)

connectionGuide.purpose: Additional ground pin, internally connected to main GND. Can be left unconnected.

warnings: If using 5V power, Echo output is 5V - use voltage divider for 3.3V GPIO
Minimum detection distance is 2cm - closer objects may not be detected
Allow 60ms between measurements for accurate readings
Soft surfaces (fabric, foam) may absorb sound and reduce range
usageNotes: Trigger/Echo mode: Send 10µs pulse on TRIG, measure HIGH time on ECHO
UART mode: Set jumper on back, send 0x55 to get 2-byte distance response
Built-in temperature compensation in UART mode
